questions.statement: It is a white food made from milk. Many people in Colombia eat it on arepas. What is it?
questions.context: En el desayuno de muchas familias de Bogotá hay arepa con un alimento blanco encima.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Chicken is meat from a bird; it is not made from milk.
Incorrect. Soup is a hot liquid food in a bowl; it is not made from milk to put on arepas.
Incorrect. Lemonade is a drink made with lemons, not a food made from milk.
Correct. Cheese is a white food made from milk, and we eat it on arepas.

questions.explanation: El queso se dice "cheese". Se hace con leche ("made from milk") y en Colombia lo comemos sobre la arepa. El pollo ("chicken") es carne, la sopa ("soup") es líquida y la limonada ("lemonade") es una bebida.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: It is a brown drink. You drink it hot, and it is made with chocolate. What is it?
questions.context: En las tardes frías de Tunja, la abuela prepara una bebida caliente con pastillas de chocolate.

options.feedback: Correct. Hot chocolate is a brown, hot drink made with chocolate.
Incorrect. Lemonade is a cold drink made with lemons, not with chocolate.
Incorrect. Soup is food we eat with a spoon, and it is not made with chocolate.
Incorrect. Ice cream is cold and frozen, so it is not a hot drink.

questions.explanation: La bebida es café ("brown"), se toma caliente ("hot") y se hace con chocolate: "hot chocolate". El helado ("ice cream") es frío y la limonada se hace con limones, así que no cumplen las pistas.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete the sentence: "Sara ___ fish. It is her favorite food."
questions.context: Sara vive en Tumaco, cerca del mar, y su comida preferida es el pescado frito.

options.feedback: Incorrect. "Like" without -s goes with I, you, we and they, not with Sara (she).
Correct. With "Sara" (she) the verb takes -s: "Sara likes fish".
Incorrect. Fish is her favorite food, so a negative is wrong; also "she" uses "doesn't", not "don't".
Incorrect. "Liking" is not the present simple form; the sentence needs "likes".

questions.explanation: Con una persona en tercera persona (Sara = "she") el verbo lleva -s: "likes". Además, el texto dice que es su comida favorita, entonces le gusta. "Don't like" sería lo contrario y además no va con "she".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read the dialogue.
Friend: "Do you like spiders?"
Tomas: "No, ___"
questions.context: En una excursión al Parque del Café, un amigo le pregunta a Tomas por las arañas.

options.feedback: Incorrect. "I do" is the positive answer, so it does not go after "No".
Incorrect. "I am not" answers "Are you...?" questions, not "Do you...?" questions.
Incorrect. "Doesn't" goes with he, she or it; with "I" we say "don't".
Correct. A "Do you...?" question gets the short negative answer "No, I don't."

questions.explanation: La pregunta "Do you like...?" se responde con "Yes, I do." o "No, I don't.". Como Tomas dice "No", la forma correcta es "I don't". "I doesn't" está mal porque "doesn't" va con he/she.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "This toy has many small pieces. You put the pieces together to make a picture." What is it?
questions.context: En la biblioteca de un colegio de Armenia hay un juguete en una caja con muchas fichas.

options.feedback: Correct. A puzzle has small pieces that you put together to make a picture.
Incorrect. A kite is one toy that flies in the sky; it has no pieces to join.
Incorrect. A ball is one round toy to kick or throw, not small pieces.
Incorrect. A teddy bear is a soft toy animal; you do not put pieces together.

questions.explanation: El rompecabezas se dice "puzzle". Tiene muchas fichas pequeñas ("small pieces") que se unen ("put together") para formar una imagen ("picture"). Los otros juguetes son de una sola pieza.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "Tomas has a toy car. It is blue and small. His sister has a big pink teddy bear." What color is the teddy bear?
questions.context: Tomas y su hermana muestran sus juguetes en la clase de inglés en Popayán.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Blue is the color of the toy car, not of the teddy bear.
Incorrect. The text does not say red; the teddy bear is pink.
Correct. The text says the sister has a big pink teddy bear.
Incorrect. Green is not in the text; the teddy bear is pink.

questions.explanation: En el texto hay dos juguetes con colores distintos. El carro de Tomas es azul ("blue") y pequeño; el oso de peluche de su hermana es grande y rosado ("pink"). Hay que fijarse a qué juguete se refiere cada color.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: It is cold and rainy in Bogota today. Which clothes are best for going to school?
questions.context: Hoy llueve mucho y hace frío en Bogotá, y Camila se está vistiendo para ir al colegio.

options.feedback: Incorrect. A swimsuit and sandals are for the beach or the pool, not for cold rain.
Correct. A raincoat and boots keep you dry and warm on a cold, rainy day.
Incorrect. Shorts leave your legs cold and wet, so they are for hot days.
Incorrect. A T-shirt and flip-flops are for hot weather; your feet get wet in the rain.

questions.explanation: Para elegir la ropa hay que mirar el clima: frío ("cold") y lluvioso ("rainy"). Un impermeable ("raincoat") y botas ("boots") protegen de la lluvia. El vestido de baño y las chanclas son para clima caliente.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "Valentina wears a white blouse, a blue skirt and black shoes to school." Which sentence is correct?
questions.context: Valentina describe su uniforme del colegio en Cúcuta.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Her shoes are black; white is the color of her blouse.
Incorrect. Her blouse is white; black is the color of her shoes.
Correct. The text says Valentina wears a blue skirt.
Incorrect. Her skirt is blue; white goes with the blouse.

questions.explanation: Cada prenda tiene su color: la blusa ("blouse") es blanca, la falda ("skirt") es azul y los zapatos ("shoes") son negros. Las opciones falsas mezclan los colores de las prendas; solo "Her skirt is blue" coincide.
questions.subject: ingles
